intro: Chol'aruk the Ravener is a feared monstrous abomination lurking in a cave on Thorn Hill within the Barrens. The local Razormane call it Chol'aruk or 'The Ravener,' and rumors claim the creature is large enough to swallow an orc whole. Bainham seeks its severed head to avenge comrades lost to similar horrors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.
Few believe such tales, but I do... Because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.
Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
